findings.expected: The UI-facing GET response separately enriches gas rows with emissions_unit = kgco2e. That enriched row was not in this current model snapshot.
findings.reason: The previous assessment used the UI-enriched draft as if it were identical to model context. CA receives no hallucination penalty for reporting an unavailable field. The save and answer assessment both pass.
